items.name: mus_P_open
items.text: A single music box note, then a delicate harpsichord arpeggio rising as a beam of light splits into a rainbow, baroque, magical crystalline shimmer, wonder, no vocals

items.name: mus_R_red
items.text: Eerie but playful baroque chamber music in C minor, music box and harpsichord with pizzicato strings, an obsessive scientist alone by candlelight at three in the morning, curious and slightly unsettling, light comedy, no vocals, 92 bpm

items.name: mus_O_orange
items.text: Lonely solo harpsichord in D minor in a large empty stone hall with long reverb, slow baroque prelude, melancholy with a dry wit, sunset, no vocals, 70 bpm

items.name: mus_Y_yellow
items.text: Bright joyful baroque allegro in E major, galloping strings and harpsichord continuo, a eureka moment, excited and quick, in the style of Handel, no vocals, 132 bpm

items.name: mus_G_green
items.text: Mock-heroic comic tension in F minor, baroque bassoon and plucked strings with sudden angry string stabs, a petty rivalry between two scholars, playful menace, no vocals, 108 bpm

items.name: mus_B_blue
items.text: Cold clockwork baroque in G major, precise staccato harpsichord and pizzicato strings over a ticking metronomic pulse, a rigged trial played as dry comedy, mechanical and smug, no vocals, 120 bpm

items.name: mus_I_indigo
items.text: Dark baroque nocturne in A minor, low strings and a slow heartbeat drum, a ruthless hunt through London at night, tense and cold, no vocals, 64 bpm

items.name: mus_V_violet
items.text: Tender solo cello in B minor, slow intimate baroque lament, a lonely childhood remembered, heartbreaking but restrained, no vocals, 60 bpm

items.name: mus_W_white
items.text: Majestic church organ and wordless choir swelling in C major, a funeral in Westminster Abbey turning into radiant light, baroque, warm and triumphant, ends on a bright held final chord, no lyrics

items.name: mus_W_button
items.text: A very short cheeky baroque harpsichord flourish ending on a comic pizzicato pluck, no vocals

items.name: mus_tavern_fiddle
items.text: A lively folk fiddle jig played live in a crowded seventeenth century London tavern, slightly rough playing, heard from across the room, no vocals

items.name: amb_room_night
items.text: Old stone college room at night, distant crickets through a window, a candle flame fluttering, faint wooden creaks, calm room tone

items.name: amb_clock_three
items.text: A distant college clock tower bell striking three times at night, crickets

items.name: amb_hall
items.text: Huge empty stone lecture hall, room tone with a long echo, wind at tall windows, a pigeon cooing far away

items.name: amb_noon
items.text: Sunny noon heard from inside an old college room, birdsong outside the window, a distant bell, faint voices in a courtyard

items.name: amb_society
items.text: Old wood panelled meeting room, gentlemen murmuring, chairs creaking, rain on the windows

items.name: amb_clock_tick
items.text: Loud slow ticking of an old pendulum clock in a quiet room

items.name: amb_tavern
items.text: Crowded seventeenth century London tavern at night, chatter, laughter, pewter mugs clinking, fire crackling

items.name: amb_office_rain
items.text: Rain on a window at night, a candle burning, a quiet wooden office

items.name: amb_dawn
items.text: Just before dawn, the first few birds singing outside a window, light wind, a candle guttering

items.name: amb_abbey
items.text: Inside a vast stone cathedral, reverberant footsteps on stone, a hushed crowd, huge room reverb

items.name: sfx_prism
items.text: Magical glass prism shimmer, crystalline sparkle as light splits into a rainbow, a rising chime

items.name: sfx_slide
items.text: Smooth airy whoosh with a crystalline shimmer, a camera gliding through coloured light

items.name: sfx_apple_thud
items.text: A single apple drops and hits a wooden floor with a dull thud and one small bounce

items.name: sfx_apple_paper
items.text: An apple drops onto a pile of paper with a papery thump

items.name: sfx_bonk
items.text: Cartoon bonk of an apple hitting someone on the head, comedic, then a microphone clattering onto a wooden floor

items.name: sfx_freeze
items.text: Comedic freeze frame sting: a quick tape stop and a camera shutter click

items.name: sfx_unfreeze
items.text: A quick reverse tape rewind blip

items.name: sfx_door
items.text: A heavy old wooden door bangs open

items.name: sfx_paper
items.text: A flurry of loose paper sheets flying and fluttering around a room

items.name: sfx_quill
items.text: A quill pen scratching steadily on parchment

items.name: sfx_book_slam
items.text: A thick manuscript slammed down hard on a wooden table

items.name: sfx_clap
items.text: One person clapping alone in a huge empty echoing hall, then stopping

items.name: sfx_punch
items.text: Short comedic whoosh zoom hit

items.name: sfx_coin
items.text: Old silver coins dropping and spinning on a wooden table

items.name: sfx_letter
items.text: An old paper letter being unfolded

items.name: sfx_letter_fold
items.text: An old paper letter folded closed and set down on a desk

items.name: sfx_chair
items.text: An old wooden chair creaking as someone sits down slowly

items.name: sfx_bite
items.text: A single crunchy bite of food

items.name: sfx_recombine
items.text: A shimmering crystalline whoosh rising into a bright radiant swell of light

items.name: sfx_bell_toll
items.text: A single deep church bell toll with long reverb

items.name: sfx_candle_snuff
items.text: A candle being snuffed out, short
